Component.description: One declared component, service or hook provider, and what a check found.

name.description: The name the session declares it under.
name.title: Name

group.description: The section of the session file it belongs to.
group.title: Group

plugin_name.description: The plugin its entry names; absent for a class the session declares in code.
plugin_name.title: Plugin Name

plugin_id.description: The id of its entry in that plugin's manifest.
plugin_id.title: Plugin Id

class.description: Its class, as `module:ClassName`; absent when it could not be found.
class.title: Class

reason.description: Why it failed, or why the check could not decide.
reason.title: Reason

Component.title: Component

Lookup.description: One name the session file looks up, and what a check found.

section.description: The section of the session file the name is in.
section.title: Section

name.description: The name as the section writes it, such as `ctrl.sig_moved -> panel.show`.
name.title: Name

status.description: Whether the name would be found.
status.title: Status

reason.description: Why it failed, or why the check could not decide.
reason.title: Reason

Lookup.title: Lookup

kind.description:
What the problem is about.

`manifest` is a plugin manifest that was skipped, or a plugin or entry
that was not found; `value` a value of a session file that is refused;
`session` a session that cannot be made or read at all; and `parameter` a
constructor parameter that cannot be described.
kind.title: Kind

where.description: What it was found in: for a manifest, the name of the plugin; for a value, its key path; for a session, the files.
where.title: Where

message.description: What is wrong, as `redsun` logs it.
message.title: Message

description: Whether a session file would build, found without building it.

redsun.description: The version of `redsun` that wrote the report.
redsun.title: Redsun

format.description: The value of `FORMAT` when the report was written.
format.title: Format

problems.description: What the command found wrong, empty when nothing is.
problems.title: Problems

components.description: Each declared component, service and hook provider.
components.title: Components

lookups.description: Each name in `layout`, `wiring`, `pairs` and the stacks.
lookups.title: Lookups

skipped.description: What the check could not look at.
skipped.title: Skipped

title: CheckReport
